text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I find Sweep Tosho
reading a
textbook with unusual focus.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Mmm... So when the wind is... then
the
object is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Of course! I need to be smart if
I'm gonna
be a great witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We learned about wind power in science
class
today. You know, like how wind
puts force on an
object, and... um, then
it, uh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyways! The point is, I can run even
faster if I
use the power of wind!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's whip up some wind and see how
fast I can
get! Come on, let's get to the
track!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Winning wind flower! Tailwind, blow
forth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's surely by chance, but a gust of wind
kicks up
just as she finishes chanting her
spell.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yesss! I did it! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But this is no time to celebrate! I've
gotta ride this
tailwind to go faster than
ev—ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A particularly strong gust of wind blows
away
Sweep Tosho's hat!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait! Stop it, wind! I said stoooop!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But I gotta say, running with the
wind at my
back feels even better than
normal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to chasing her hat around,
Sweep Tosho
seems to have grasped
something that helps
improve her
running!
